texts: In the book, off-pump bypass uses full-dose heparin, 300 units per kilogram, and the activated clotting time is repeated every 20 minutes: D, A and C, is the answer.
The book keeps the activated clotting time well above 250 seconds, so B is wrong.
Without the pump, the coronary arteries are still opened and blood stagnates around the stabilizer, so clotting must be prevented.
Memory hook: a full-size hare holds up 300, and Nami turns the 20-minute hourglass again and again.
